title: RNA Extraction From Mouse Tissue
author: Yujie Fan
materials: Make small incision in the right ventricle.
Once the perfusate runs clear, stop pump
From here on we follow the Qiagen Rneasy Mini Columns Protocol (Cat No 74104, Qiagen) for converting animal tissue into RNA.

steps.title: Sterilize Workstation and Tools
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and tools to prevent RNA contamination.

substeps.instruction: Spray all surfaces and tools with 70% ethanol followed by RNASE-ZAP.
Prepare a 50 ml tube containing RNASE-ZAP and place tools inside until perfusion begins.
Sterilize the mouse perfusion surface with 70% ethanol followed by RNASE-ZAP.

steps.title: Prepare Cooling and Freezing Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up temperature-controlled environments for tissue collection and preservation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two cooling blocks at 0°C or lower.
Place Petri dishes filled with sterile DPBS on top of the cooling blocks.
Prepare a bucket of dry ice for snap freezing extracted tissue.

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion System and Tubes
steps.instruction: Ensure all reagents and containers are ready for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Verify the perfusion pump is PFA free.
Ensure DPBS is sterile filtered and kept on ice.
Label DNA LO BIND 1.5 mL tubes for the specific mouse and target tissues.

steps.title: Anesthetize and Secure Mouse
steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia and stabilize the animal for surgery.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse using pentobarbital sodium and phenytoin sodium (approximately 100 ul for a 30g mouse).
Confirm deep anesthesia via paw pinch (mouse should not respond).
Secure mouse paws to styrofoam using four 26g needles.

steps.title: Perform Perfusion
steps.instruction: Flush the circulatory system with DPBS.

substeps.instruction: Make an incision along the abdomen extending up to the rib cage.
Expose the chest cavity and secure it with hemostats clamped to the xiphoid process.
Insert a 22g needle into the left ventricle and secure it with a hemostat.
Immediately start the peristaltic pump connected to sterile filtered DPBS at a flow rate of 10 mL/min.

steps.title: Extract and Process Tissue
steps.instruction: Isolate target tissues and preserve them for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Remove the required tissue from the animal and place it into the DPBS on the cooling core (e.g., remove the intestinal tract for duodenum extraction).
Repeat for all desired tissues.
Make small precise cuts to isolate roughly 30mg of tissue and place into the labeled DNA LO BIND 1.5 mL tubes.
Immediately place the DNA LO BIND 1.5 mL tubes into dry ice to snap freeze the tissue.

steps.title: Store Tissue
steps.instruction: Store the snap-frozen tissue at -80°C until RNA conversion is required.
